'''Chiilaks''' were six-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] [[Ocean/Legends|marine]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Misnor]]'s glacial regions. They were strong swimmers and omnivorous, being excellent hunters. Hunting them was legal under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but considered dangerous.<ref name="CotG" />
